machine: Apple M1 Max, 32 GB unified memory

production_batched.interpretation: the profiler is off by default and does not change the one-command-buffer production path; the GPU spread is ordinary run-to-run variation

synchronous_dispatch_profile.note: profile mode intentionally commits and waits per dispatch to obtain GPU timestamps, so its aggregate is diagnostic rather than the production latency

correctness.profile_1024: finite deterministic zero-latent smoke; no official 1024 VAE oracle is currently available

unit_tests.interpretation: environment-sensitive TCP sandbox failures unrelated to the VAE; all project tests passed

decision.elementwise_and_submission: no-go: norms, adds, clamp, and all remaining work total only 1.53%; production already uses one command buffer
decision.fp16_convolution: no-go under the existing tight FP32 decoder oracle
decision.remaining_compute_target: the FP32 cooperative-matrix convolution family, including parity-decomposed upsample convolution
decision.f5_status: complete; retain the current runtime and use this profile to gate any future convolution-kernel or exact FP32 MPSGraph experiment
